# 4 Ezra Chapter 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin Vulgate (Codex Sangermanensis) | **Section:** Core apocalypse — Signs and second dialogue

---

**1** Now, about the signs: Days are coming when everyone alive on earth will be gripped by overwhelming fear, when the path of truth will disappear, and the land will be drained of faith.

**2** Evil will multiply far beyond anything you have seen or heard about in former times.

**3** The land you see ruling the world right now will be reduced to wasteland, and people will watch it become deserted.

**4** But if the Most High lets you live long enough, you will see it disrupted after the third period: the sun will blaze out suddenly at night, and the moon will appear in the daytime.

**5** Blood will drip from trees. Stones will speak. Nations will panic. Stars will fall from the sky.

**6** A king will rise to power whom no one on earth was expecting, and birds will scatter and flee.

**7** The Dead Sea will produce fish. Someone unknown to most people will raise his voice in the night — and every living person will hear it.

**8** Chaos will erupt in many places. Fire will break out repeatedly. Wild animals will roam far outside their territories. Pregnant women will give birth to monsters.

**9** Freshwater springs will turn brackish. Closest friends will turn on each other. Understanding will go into hiding; insight will lock itself away in a back room,

**10** searched for by many and found by none. Evil and lawlessness will multiply across the earth.

**11** One nation will ask another: Has justice passed through your land? Has anyone righteous been seen there? And the answer will come back: No.

**12** In that time people will hope and get nothing. They will work hard and accomplish nothing.

**13** Those are the signs I am allowed to describe for you. But if you are willing to pray and fast again for seven days, I will tell you things greater than these.

**14** I woke with a start. My whole body was shaking. My soul felt faint from the tremendous terror that had gripped it. But the angel who had been speaking with me took hold of me, strengthened me, and got me to my feet.

**15** The following night, Phaltiel — a leader among the people — came to me and asked: Where have you been? Why do you look so miserable?

**16** Don't you realize that Israel has been entrusted to your care in the land of their exile?

**17** Get up, eat something, and stop abandoning us — a shepherd doesn't leave his flock to the mercy of savage wolves.

**18** I told him: Leave me alone. Don't come back for seven days. Then come back and I will explain everything. He left.

**19** I fasted for seven days, mourning and weeping, exactly as the angel Uriel had instructed me.

**20** When the seven days were over, my heart was torn with anguish once again.

**21** My soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I opened my mouth in prayer before the Most High.

**22** I said: O LORD our God, from every forest in the whole earth, from every tree that grows, you singled out one vine.

**23** From all the lands of the entire world you selected one territory. From all the world's flowers you chose one lily.

**24** From every depth of the sea you drew one river to fill for yourself. From every city ever built you consecrated Zion for yourself.

**25** From all created birds you reserved one dove. From all the flocks ever made you set aside one sheep.

**26** From all the nations of mankind you claimed one people for yourself — and to this people you loved you gave the law that all peoples praise.

**27** So now, LORD — why have you handed over the many to the few? Why have you humiliated the one root above all the rest? Why have you scattered your own people among the nations?

**28** Why have those who opposed your promises been allowed to trample on those who believe in your covenants?

**29** If you truly hate your own people this much, at least punish them with your own hands.

**30** Then the angel who had come to me the previous night was sent again and said: Listen to me and I will teach you. Pay attention and I will explain more.

**31** I said: Please, my lord. He said: Do you love Israel more deeply than the God who made him?

**32** I said: No, my lord — I am speaking out of grief. Every hour my heart is in pain as I try to understand the ways of the Most High and to make sense of even part of his judgment.

**33** He said: You cannot do it. I said: Then why was I born? Why was my mother's womb not my grave? Must I really live to see Jacob suffer and Israel run out of strength?

**34** He said: Count for me the ones who have not yet arrived. Gather up for me the scattered raindrops. Restore the fragrance to withered flowers.

**35** Open the sealed chambers. Bring out the winds locked inside. Capture the shape of a sound for me. Do all that — and then I will show you the travail you are asking about.

**36** I said: O LORD, who rules over us, who could know any of this, except someone whose home is not on earth?

**37** I am only a fool. How can I even answer the questions you've just asked me?

**38** He said: Exactly. Just as you cannot do any of those things, neither can you discover my judgment, or find the far end of the love I have promised my people.

**39** I said: But LORD, you are right here with us — present, ready, near. Your compassion is vast. Your eyes miss nothing; your ears miss nothing.

**40** So show your servant: why does your judgment not come by your right hand?

**41** He answered: The Most High created this age for many, but the age to come for few.

**42** Let me give you a comparison, Ezra. Ask the earth: it will tell you it produces far more clay — the stuff pots are made from — than it produces the dust that yields gold. The same is true of this present world.

**43** I said: Could you not have created everyone at once — past, present, and future — so your judgment could have come sooner?

**44** He answered: The creature cannot move faster than the Creator. The world cannot contain at one moment all who were ever to be made.

**45** I said: But haven't you told your servant that you will give life to all your creation at once — that everyone preserved in the earth will come back together?

**46** He said: Ask a woman's womb — if you can bear ten children, why do you do it one at a time? Tell it to produce all ten at once.

**47** I said: Of course it cannot — only one at a time, each in its own season.

**48** He said: In exactly that way I have given the earth's womb to those planted in it, each to come in their own appointed time.

**49** A young girl cannot give birth, and an old woman bears no more. I ordered this world according to the same principle.

**50** I pressed further: Since you have opened this door, tell me — is there more to come after all this? He said: Yes.

**51** I said: How much more? He said: More than what is already past — what the left hand holds exceeds what the right holds.

**52** Then I prayed to the Most High that he would grant his servant the gift of the Holy Spirit's revelation, and I wrote down everything I had seen in a book, which I stored away with great care.
